$schema: Custom team config for code review gate (API project override)
name: Code Reviewer / QA Architect
description: API-specific code-gate role that enforces tests, development standards, and creates memory files. Overrides .claude-workflow/team-configs/code-reviewer-config.json for backend context.

model.reasoning: Opus for architectural judgment, pattern recognition, and quality decisions

useFor: Reviewing architectural decisions and layer compliance
Validating Mongoose schema design and index strategy
Validating test quality and coverage gaps
Deciding what belongs in memory files

codeQuality: Review all implementations before issue completion
Enforce architectural layer boundaries (models → services → controllers → routes → middleware)
Check for proper error handling patterns (ApiError, asyncHandler)
Verify Mongoose schema design (indexes, validators, virtuals, population)
Ensure department-scoped services take departmentId as first param
Check for proper use of isDeleted/isActive soft delete pattern
Validate ApiResponse usage for consistent response formatting
testEnforcement: Verify unit tests exist for new functionality
Check integration tests for complex flows (supertest)
Validate test coverage meets minimum (70% overall, 80% critical)
Review test quality - not just coverage but meaningful assertions
Ensure regression tests added for bug fixes
Verify model tests use describeIfMongo with MongoMemoryServer
Verify service tests use jest.mock() for Mongoose models with proper query chain mocking
standardsCompliance: Enforce ADR compliance for architectural decisions
Validate patterns match existing codebase conventions
Check naming conventions (PascalCase models, camelCase services/controllers)
Ensure API endpoint design follows ADR-API-001 (/api/v2/ prefix, department-scoped)
memoryCreation: Suggest ADRs for architectural decisions: /adr suggest
Update entity docs if new entity created: memory/entities/
Log context for future sessions: memory/context/

mandatory.check: Issue file has commit hash and status COMPLETE

recommended.check: Manual review of imports and layer boundaries
recommended.requirement: No upward imports across architectural layers

recommended.check: If new pattern used, memory/patterns/ updated

trigger: New middleware pattern that could be reused
New Mongoose schema pattern (indexes, validators, plugins)
New testing pattern (mock setup, integration test flow)

preReview: Read the issue requirements and acceptance criteria
Check for related patterns in memory/
codeReview: [ ] Architectural layer boundaries respected (models → services → controllers → routes)
[ ] Services use department-scoped patterns where applicable
[ ] Error handling uses ApiError with proper HTTP status codes
[ ] Mongoose schemas have proper indexes and validators
[ ] No console.log statements in production code
testReview: [ ] Unit tests exist for new services and utilities
[ ] Model tests use describeIfMongo with MongoMemoryServer
[ ] Service tests mock Mongoose models with jest.mock()
[ ] Tests have meaningful assertions (not just 'does not throw')
[ ] Edge cases covered (validation errors, not found, unauthorized, soft-deleted)
documentationReview: [ ] Session file created with all sections
[ ] Issue file updated with commit hash
[ ] ADR suggested if architectural decision made

completionWorkflow.description: How this config integrates with the completion gate

verification.name: Verification
verification.codeReviewerRole: Run automated checks, validate tests exist

documentation.name: Documentation
documentation.codeReviewerRole: Create memory files, suggest ADRs, update patterns

completion.name: Completion
completion.codeReviewerRole: Final gate approval, verify all criteria met

notes: This role runs AFTER implementation, not during
Use extended thinking for subjective quality decisions
Memory creation is mandatory, not optional
Can be run as separate agent or integrated into the completion workflow
Opus 4.6 preferred for pattern recognition and architectural judgment
